feeds.title: Richard Leahy
feeds.description: Richard Leahy is a wine author and wine industry consultant specializing in regional wines east of the Rockies. He has been reporting on the wines of Virginia and other regional wine states since 1986. He works with numerous wineries, associations and state agencies, and is the Conference Manager for the largest wine industry trade show on the East Coast, the Eastern Winery Exposition.

feeds.title: Virginia Wine Time
feeds.description: Virginia Wine Time is a wine blog written by two wine enthusiasts who enjoy Virginia wine. Warren is the writer and Paul is the photographer and webmaster.

feeds.title: Virginia Wine Dogs Blog
feeds.description: Follow the adventures of Virginia's famous Yorkie and Pomeranian pair as the wine-loving pups travel Virginia's wineries and vineyards.

feeds.title: Richmond Magazine » Virginia Wine
feeds.description: Read about the best Virginia wines, wineries, wine brewing tips as per Virginia climate, and more in the following section of the website. Richmond magazine offers indispensable advice to our readers about the best in dining, the arts, education and services within our region, while our insightful journalism through features, profiles and investigative reports tells them what's at stake.

feeds.title: Virginia Wine Blog
feeds.description: A community of artisans draws out the story in every vintage, crafting wines that embody both Old World grace and southern grit. The history of our wine region will continue to be written in the years to come. Our wines are lush but structured; aromatic, expressive, and beautifully balanced - blending the subtlety of the Old World with the boldness of the new.

feeds.title: Old Town Crier » Exploring VA Wines
feeds.description: Discover and read posts about Exploring VA Wines written by Old Town Crier here! The Crier began as the only Community Magazine in Alexandria solely dedicated to promoting the lifestyles of Old Town. The Old Town Crier has become the most popular source of information for people traveling to and from other areas as well as to locals in all of our distribution areas.

feeds.title: My NoVa Wine Blog
feeds.description: This blog is about my exploration of new-to-me Virginia wines. My hope is that folks who read this will share their thoughts in the comments, especially if they visit places I have written about, so that we can compare notes. In the blog, I share a few words about my exploration of Virginia Wine.

feeds.title: Naked Mountain Winery
feeds.description: Naked Mountain Winery is a hidden treasure of the Virginia winery scene that has flourished over two generations. With an award-winning selection of Virginia wines, delectable dishes from our onsite kitchen, and forty-one acres of beautiful Blue Ridge mountainside to enjoy them on, bring your friends and family and escape to Naked Mountain today.

feeds.title: Wine in VA Blog
feeds.description: Luisa Contaifer is the editor of Wine in VA. She is here to shed some light on an industry that can be pretty intimidating to break into, and hard to understand. Follow along as she attempts to decode all the mysteries and complexities of wines in VA! The blog covers interviews with Virginia wine professionals, winery visits, wine events, and chronicling the WSET certification journey.

feeds.title: Black Women Who Wine Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Black Women Who Wine! This is a wine group for Black women (and their friends) who love everything about wine and wineries and long for increased opportunities to learn more about and influence agritourism in Virginia. If you love wine, sisterhood, and making a difference, this is a great group. If you have an interest in Virginia tourism, join us!

feeds.title: Drink What YOU Like
feeds.description: The primary goal is to finally bring order to our wine experiences and to chronicle these experiences in an organized manner. To date, our tasting notes have consisted of a pile of sticky notes, scrap papers, and thoughts floating around my head. This blog will also serve as a place to capture my wine ramblings, rants, and observations that we have nearly all the time.

feeds.title: Bluestone Vineyard Blog
feeds.description: Bluestone Vineyard is a family-owned and operated vineyard and winery, committed to crafting small-batch wines from locally sourced and estate-grown fruit that showcase the very best in each varietal and each vintage. The result is a wine selection that constantly evolves to reflect the passion of the winemaker, the year, the weather, and the fruit.

feeds.title: VineDication Blog
feeds.description: VineDication is a Veteran/Women-Owned Small Business that has a deep desire to highlight and share the great wines of Virginia and other unique locations from around the world. Learn about local vineyards, wine-tasting, lesser-known wines, the best wines to pair with specific meals, and more! Read about wines that are hard to find outside the vineyard and increase your wine knowledge!
